content_completeness.evidence: 11 reviewed recovery items; primary inventory coverage 48 to 50 units. Unit presence is not exhaustive topic coverage. Only reviewed fields enter the student subset.
content_completeness.acceptance: All important topics and qualifications independently inventoried against source, with no material omission.
content_completeness.remaining: Full document topic inventory and 1,100 remaining unreviewed field leaves.

factual_faithfulness.evidence: Six overgeneralized or unsupported main assertions revised with original strings retained. The empty-string array-default assertion is withheld as INCONCLUSIVE.
factual_faithfulness.acceptance: No unsupported or contradicted factual assertions after independent source and technical review.
factual_faithfulness.remaining: Source correctness is distinct from source entailment; local Java probe timed out.

explanation_quality.evidence: Restored package-registration qualification, counter-free loop context, value-comparison distinction, condition timing and normalization purpose.
explanation_quality.acceptance: A learner can explain why the operations and qualifications matter using only supported material.
explanation_quality.remaining: No learner comprehension study; broad explanations remain unreviewed.

organization.evidence: Topic headings, primary-source ordering, explicit error/correction roles, numbered steps and one equivalence cross-reference.
organization.acceptance: Logical progression with prerequisites and correction relationships clear.
organization.remaining: Source sequence is a conservative order, not a validated optimal curriculum.

examples.evidence: Reviewed verbal examples and complete arithmetic displays retained; 40 nonliteral reconstructed snippets remain in the audit and are withheld.
examples.acceptance: Examples are source-supported, correctly scoped and clearly marked when deliberately incorrect.
examples.remaining: No restored literal code where source lacks exact code; incomplete mortgage formula still withheld.

traceability.evidence: Independent serialized-artifact check recomputes field values, SUPPORTED dispositions, exact canonical quotes, rendered text presence and alias targets.
traceability.acceptance: Every displayed factual field has a correct canonical source and reviewed support.
traceability.remaining: Matching references do not prove entailment or factual truth.

readability_and_usability.evidence: Long evidence quotations moved to audit; student text uses topic headings and concise field citations.
readability_and_usability.acceptance: No material content loss and usable notes confirmed by an independent reader.
readability_and_usability.remaining: The restricted preview deliberately withholds most unreviewed knowledge. No independent reader or accessibility study.
